description: All live deals at one store, exact name match — e.g. 'Amazon', 'Walmart', 'Costco', 'B&H'. Use for 'what deals does Walmart have?' questions. An optional sort orders them: 'price_asc' cheapest first, 'price_desc' priciest first, 'discount_desc' biggest percent off first. Results link to each deal's page on stackthedeal.com only.

offset.description: Pagination: skip this many matches (use the next_offset from the previous result to page further).

sort.description: Sort order: "relevance" (default — best match / catalog order), "price_asc" (cheapest first — use when the user asks for the cheapest), "price_desc" (priciest first), "discount_desc" (biggest percent off first).

store.description: Store name, e.g. Amazon, Walmart, Costco.

name: list_deals_by_store
title: Live deals at one store
